name: claude-usage
description: Shows your Claude plan utilization (5-hour session and weekly limits) and Claude Code token usage in the VS Code status bar.

claudeUsage.fetchPlanUsage.description: Fetch plan limits (the same numbers as /usage in Claude Code) from Anthropic using your existing Claude Code login. When off, only local token counts are shown.

claudeUsage.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often (seconds) to fetch plan utilization from Anthropic.

claudeUsage.claudeDir.description: Claude Code config folder. Leave empty to use CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude.

claudeUsage.warningThreshold.description: Percent at which the status bar turns yellow.

claudeUsage.criticalThreshold.description: Percent at which the status bar turns red.
